debian_mirror.description: Official Debian mirror to use to get Debian packages

backports_mirror.description: Backports mirror URL, defaults to debian_mirror

locale.description: Preselect this default locale for the distribution

keyboard.description: Preselect this keyboard layout (e.g., us, de, fr)

kernel_packages.description: List of kernel packages to include on the CD

profiles.description: List of profiles to select (examples in profiles/ dir)

build_profiles.description: Profiles only used while building the CD

local_packages.description: List of .deb files included on CD's local package repository

profiles_udeb_dist.description: Pull simple-cdd-profiles udeb from specified distribution

extra_udeb_dist.description: Pull in udebs from specified distribution

logfile.description: Specify a file where the full execution log will be written

mirror_tools.description: List the mirror tools to be used (default: download reprepro)

build_tools.description: List the build tools to be used (default: debian-cd)

serial_console.description: Enable serial console when booting the ISO image

proposed_updates.description: Specify if proposed updates should be used

force_preseed.description: Only issue a warning if a preseeding file is invalid
